Our Story

More Than a Watch — An Experience

Aura Unveiled by Cess was born from a passion for timeless elegance and accessible luxury. Based in the heart of Nairobi, we believe every wrist deserves a watch that tells more than just the time — it tells your story.

We handpick every timepiece from trusted global manufacturers, ensuring you receive authentic, quality watches at honest prices. From bold mens chronographs to delicate ladies jewel-chain watches, our collection is curated with love.

Every order comes with complimentary gift packaging, and we deliver right to your doorstep at your convenience.
